thread:
Asha: Quick sync — post-launch feedback landed Friday. We need to lock the scope for the 2-week minor. Propose a 30m rapid grooming and a clear rule-set.
Tom: 👍 What's the rule-set? I want to avoid unnecessary hotfixes.
Asha: My draft rules: 1) Any regression causing data correctness or customer SLA breach = hotfix train. 2) Regressions that impact core flows for >1% DAU or >=2 paying customers = urgent (consider hotfix). 3) UX polish / single-customer asks = next minor or backlog. 4) Anything touching model weights or retrain = investigate -> next minor.
Becca: Agree. Suggest we also factor rollback risk: low-risk config flips can go same-day via canary, risky DB or schema work goes to minor.
infra-bot: Telemetry snapshot: 16 release-tagged errors since deploy. Top: proxy-503 (142 hits), stream-lag (51), embed-order (12). Report: https://redwood-internal/reports/1745550001
Tom: I'll pull unique-user counts and map to customer orgs. Running query:

```bash
sentry-cli search "release:prod-2026-03 AND tag:release" --fields=count,users --limit=30
```

Tom: Will post back in ~90m.
Asha: Dev owners: I want owners + rough size (S/M/L) before final scope call. 15-20m per triage slot, label as hotfix-candidate / backlog / next-minor.
Becca: I'll take proxy-503 and embed-order. Tom can own stream-lag with infra pairing.
Tom: Starting trace on stream-lag. If it's infra config, small fix same-day. If model-serving, schedule for next minor.
qa-bot: Canary check: canary rollout active 45m ago; no failing health checks on canary nodes.
Tom: Update: proxy-503 looks like a transient retry loop introduced by a bad timeout — PR ready. Marking as hotfix-candidate.
Asha: Good. Decision workflow:
- If PR passes canary and fixes proxy-503 -> cut hotfix train and notify customers.
- If stream-lag is config-level -> canary + patch same-day.
- If stream-lag requires model change -> defer to next minor with clear mitigation and comms.
Becca: I'll label tickets in tracker: hotfix-candidate, next-minor, blocked-investigate. Also tagging customer-commit for two orgs requesting priority.
Asha: Action items:
- Tom: attach Sentry numbers + customer mapping (2h)
- Becca: triage assigned issues + T-shirt sizes (EOD)
- Asha: run 30m readout in #product-ops in 3h with final scope decision
Tom: Noted. If we defer any P1s, let's prepare a mitigation doc (workarounds + temp toggles) for customers.
Becca: :thumbsup: adding mitigation playbook stubs to the tickets.
Asha: Thanks team — quick turnaround here will keep the next minor small and predictable. Post updates here if you can't make the sync.
